reviews.title: Dave
reviews.text:
Just a blurry mess. If you only want to zoom all the way out and see state and country lines you're in luck.
If the point of the frustrating log in just to try all the buttons and see a blurry mess is to lure you to buy the version that actually works, I'm not biting. If you let people see the real deal for a day or two, that would be great. I'm not buying an unknown product.

reviews.title: Inaccurate Data!!!
reviews.text:
I subscribed to Zoom Earth Pro primarily for weather forecasting, but the forecast temperatures have been significantly inaccurate.

For several days, Zoom Earth has shown temperatures around 23–24°C for London and similarly low values across parts of Western Europe, while national meteorological agencies and multiple independent forecasts have been indicating a major heatwave with temperatures exceeding 34–35°C.

This is period of end of June 2026

This is not a small forecasting difference. The discrepancy has been around 10°C and has persisted across multiple forecast updates.

The satellite imagery is excellent, but I can no longer rely on the forecast data. As a Pro subscriber, this is very disappointing.

reviews.title: I did NOT consent to ads
reviews.text: I recently opened this app on my phone for the first time in a while and was extremely disappointed to see the effective screen size had been reduced and there was a wide banner ad at the bottom of the screen. I have neither updated the app or my OS or anything, so they made this change on their end. Very disappointing and classless. I’m so thoroughly tired of ad culture infecting EVERYTHING.
